1.title: A 'dark cloud' and 'dismal' mood: How it feels on Cornell campus right now
1.summary: Students tell the BBC that the tension on campus has become palpable since allegations from 2024 resurfaced.

2.title: Tennessee Botches One Execution After Another, Despite Repeated Warnings
2.summary: The failed attempt with Christa Pike has intensified bipartisan concerns about Tennessee’s ability to effectively carry out lethal injections.

3.title: Carmel-by-the-Sea Reluctantly Adopts Street Addresses After 110 Years
3.summary: Driven by emergency response needs, Carmel-by-the-Sea reluctantly adopted street address numbers this summer, igniting concerns over its vanishing identity as a beachside village.

4.title: Christa Pike in critical condition after surviving two lethal injections, lawyer says
4.summary: Pike’s lawyers have asked for her death sentence to be commuted following the botched execution.

5.title: ‘I Couldn’t Let All of Them Die’: Pilot on FlyDubai Flight Recalls Sudden Attack
5.summary: Capt. Smit Machchhar, who was stabbed by his co-pilot midair between Dubai and Tel Aviv, said he “had to act” to prevent a crash despite serious injuries.

6.title: Airlines Set to Bring Israelis Back From U.A.E. After FlyDubai Cockpit Attack
6.summary: The attack, on a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv, halted the only direct service between the two cities since the war in Iran disrupted air traffic.
